2609.02417.title: Coverage, Not Targeting: A Structural Regime in Multi-Turn Agent Credit Assignment
2609.02417.paper_summary: Multi-turn agentic RL increasingly treats credit assignment as a targeting problem: given a terminal verifiable reward, per-turn methods localize credit onto the turns that mattered. We identify the structural quantity that predicts when this is the right move, the verifier information density V_d = k/C (the fraction of an agent's C-step causal chain whose per-turn correctness the verifier exposes), and show that terminal-state verifiers sit deep in a low-V_d regime where targeting is the wrong axis. In controlled shared-rollout comparisons on tau^2-bench that separate reward density from credit geometry, a continuous dense reward spread uniformly beats the sparse binary outcome reward (net-harmful on 4/5 seeds), while concentrating the same advantage on progress turns or on random turns is equally harmful: targeting is second-order. The mechanism is coverage: terminal-state verification collapses the observable signal to a single final-write turn (k=1 in 98% of rollouts) while success requires a 5-8 step chain of prerequisite tool calls. A synthetic phase boundary places the crossover at V_d* ~ 0.8, whereas measured V_d is ~0.15 on tau^2-bench and ~0.4 on BFCL V3; uniform also wins on BFCL, where a matched-concentration shuffled control is negative on 8/8 seeds. The effect reproduces across model families on ToolACE-2-8B (Delta = -0.048 over 32 pre-registered seeds; an independent 20-seed replication is itself significant), and a pre-registered matched-budget breadth sweep traces a monotone dose-response whose deficit vanishes only at full chain coverage, with a reward-to-go arm reaching full-coverage parity. Uniform redistribution is the zero-information coverage default that per-turn schemes must beat; we contribute the matched-concentration shuffled control that any targeting claim should clear.
2609.02417.paper_summary_zh: 多回合的代理強化學習越來越將信用分配視為一個目標問題：給定一個可驗證的終端獎勵，每回合方法將信用定位於重要的回合。我們確定了預測何時這是正確舉動的結構量，驗證者信息密度 V_d = k/C（代理的 C 步因果鏈中，驗證者揭示的每回合正確性所佔的比例），並顯示終端狀態驗證者位於低 V_d 範疇，這裡目標定位是錯誤的軸。在 tau^2-bench 上進行的受控共享回合比較中，將獎勵密度與信用幾何分開，持續密集的獎勵均勻地超越了稀疏的二元結果獎勵（在 4/5 的種子上造成淨損害），而將相同的優勢集中在進展回合或隨機回合上同樣有害：目標定位是二階的。這一機制是覆蓋：終端狀態驗證將可觀察信號壓縮到單一的最終寫入回合（在 98% 的回合中 k=1），而成功需要 5-8 步的前提工具調用鏈。合成相位邊界將交叉點放在 V_d* ~ 0.8，而在 tau^2-bench 上測得的 V_d 約為 ~0.15，在 BFCL V3 上約為 ~0.4；在 BFCL 上均勻分配也勝出，匹配濃度的隨機控制在 8/8 的種子上為負。這一效應在 ToolACE-2-8B 的模型家族中重現（在 32 個預註冊的種子上 Delta = -0.048；獨立的 20 種子重複實驗本身也顯著），而預註冊的匹配預算廣度掃描描繪出一個單調劑量反應，其缺口僅在完全鏈覆蓋時消失，獎勵到達臂達到完全覆蓋的平價。均勻重分配是每回合方案必須超越的零信息覆蓋默認值；我們貢獻了匹配濃度的隨機控制，任何目標聲明都應清除此控制。
